tests_written.rationale: Tests cover five-host lifecycle, native Codex registration, rollback, zero residue, legacy upgrade, and pre-existing registry preservation.

tests_passed.rationale: The focused lifecycle suite and an independent CLI sandbox both exited zero.

persistence_real.rationale: Adapters use real temporary filesystems and Codex uses its real native plugin registry inside the isolated root.

feature_flags_audit.rationale: Installed owner/model visibility and host limitations are asserted directly instead of hidden behind flags.

vertical_slice.rationale: The CLI performs install, Doctor, reinstall, and uninstall for all five hosts through their adapters.

spec_trace.rationale: The architecture anchor records each native layout, routing policy, and visible limitation.

limitations: Codex Hook trust remains a user-controlled post-install action and is reported separately from installation health.
